what: expect_file remaps for the four mirror re-pins (tldr-pages, zalando, whatwg-specs, govuk-design-system). The wave-1 suites were authored against the upstream layout; the corpora are now scoped mirrors. QUERIES AND EXPECT CLAUSES ARE UNCHANGED — only the file location each clause was grep-verified in moved. Every remapped expect_file re-verified (whitespace-normalized substring) against the mirror on disk. Zero exclusions after chapters/compatibility.adoc was restored to the zalando mirror (2c6ef7f) — the initial scoping had wrongly dropped it as boilerplate.

remap_methods.zalando: identity — mirror chapters/ matches the suite paths
remap_methods.whatwg-specs: content-located (grep the mirror for the verbatim clause)

tldr-pages.shape_risk: No content file over 4MB (biggest non-git files are assets, e.g. scripts/pdf/NotoSans-Regular.ttf 556 KB); the shape risk is ~39,849 tiny pages/**/*.md files, not size

queries.q: How do I extract a tar archive into a specific target directory?
queries.expect: tar xf {{path/to/source.tar.ext}} {{[-C|--directory]}} {{path/to/directory}}

queries.q: How do I make curl download a file and keep the original filename from the URL?
queries.expect: curl {{[-O|--remote-name]}} {{https://example.com/filename.zip}}

queries.q: How do I give the owner of a file permission to execute it?
queries.expect: chmod u+x {{path/to/file}}

queries.q: Which command opens the current user's crontab for editing?
queries.expect: - [e]dit the crontab file for the current user:

queries.q: How do I watch a log file live while a program keeps writing to it?
queries.expect: tail {{[-f|--follow]}} {{path/to/file}}

queries.q: Why do the Zalando API guidelines prefer cursor-based pagination over offset-based pagination?
queries.expect: Offset-based pagination may create duplicates or lead to missing entries

queries.q: Are Zalando API endpoints allowed to be open, or does every endpoint need protection?
queries.expect: Every API endpoint must be protected and armed with authentication and authorization.

queries.q: When a Zalando API needs to change, is adding a new version preferred over compatible extensions?
queries.expect: We strongly encourage using compatible API extensions and discourage versioning

queries.q: Which proprietary HTTP header must Zalando services support so that one call can be traced across services?
queries.expect: RESTful API endpoints *must* support {X-Flow-ID} header in requests

queries.q: Why do Zalando APIs return JSON fields spelled with underscores instead of camelCase?
queries.expect: Property names are restricted to ASCII snake_case strings matching regex `^[a-z_][a-z_0-9]*$`.

whatwg-specs.shape_risk: whatwg-specs-1/source is a 7,923,481 B single-file monolith (HTML Standard source); review-drafts/ add 17 .wattsi near-duplicates (5.7-6.3MB each) in the html repo and 17 .bs near-duplicates of url.bs in the url repo

queries.q: Are tab and newline characters allowed inside a URL, and what does the URL parser do with them?
queries.expect: Remove all ASCII tab or newline from input.

queries.q: When a URL is serialized, which characters are percent-encoded in the path but left alone in the query?
queries.expect: consisting of the query percent-encode set and U+003F (?), U+005E (^), U+0060 (`),

queries.q: Why can't a URL like mailto:foo@example.org be used as the base URL for resolving a relative reference?
queries.expect: used as a base URL because it has an opaque path.

queries.q: For an input control like a range slider, when should the browser fire the change event versus the input event?
queries.expect: any time the user commits the change, the user agent must

queries.q: Does an HTML element's id attribute value have to be unique across the whole document?
queries.expect: value must be unique amongst all the IDs in the element's

govuk-design-system.shape_risk: No file over 4MB; biggest file is package-lock.json (1,301,954 B) at repo root; component .yaml files are 186-961 lines each

queries.q: How do I show an extra input when a particular radio option is selected?
queries.expect: Provide additional content to reveal when the radio is checked.

queries.q: How do I make a 'None of these' checkbox untick all the other checkboxes?
queries.expect: implements a 'None of these' type behaviour via JavaScript when checkboxes are clicked

queries.q: Should the error summary receive focus when a page with errors loads?
queries.expect: Must be focused when the page loads

queries.q: How do I stop the success notification banner from taking keyboard focus when the page loads?
queries.expect: To disable this behaviour, set `disableAutoFocus` to `true`.

queries.q: The little counter under a textarea telling users how many characters they have left is noisy; can I hide it until they get near the limit?
queries.expect: The percentage value of the limit at which point the count message is displayed
